notes: The two chief judgment calls are hyper -> more than headed on more (rule 17's meaning-bearing word over the formal prepositional than) and posoi -> how much headed on much under rule 104's degree-correlative clause; both are named in their unit notes.
sarki and kyrioi are anarthrous in the projection, so their supplied the is a rule 51 helper on the noun and no article competes.
The correlative kai ... kai is split, the first member taking both and the second and, under rule 65's English-side test.
